title: La Rosa Holdings Corp. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-06
summary: La Rosa Holdings Corp., a small-cap real estate services company listed on Nasdaq (ticker: LRHC), filed a Form 8-K disclosing a settlement agreement dated April 3, 2026. The company acquired the remaining 49% minority interest in its subsidiary La Rosa Realty Orlando LLC from two sellers, consolidating 100% ownership. The settlement involved forgiving approximately $258,742 in alleged obligations and paying $10,000 in cash to settle pending litigation.
key_points: La Rosa Holdings acquired 100% of La Rosa Realty Orlando LLC, converting it from a majority-owned to wholly-owned subsidiary
Sellers Reinaldo Zapata and Viviana Figueroa each sold their 24.5% membership interests
Obligations forgiven: $106,447 (personal loan) and $152,295 (franchise fee under personal guaranty)
Cash payment of $10,000 made to Ms. Figueroa
Pending litigation (Case No. 2026-CA-001011-O) in Orange County, Florida dismissed without prejudice
Settlement includes mutual releases of claims between all parties
